description: PV generator is MATLAB code from the Institute for Automation of Complex Power Systems at the E.ON Energy Research Center, RWTH Aachen University, that generates realistic photovoltaic power injection profiles for one day. The FEIN Aachen project page links it to the paper by Pau, Angioni, Ponci and Monti, 'A Tool for the Generation of Realistic PV Profiles for Distribution Grid Simulations', listed there as under review. Coverage: single-day PV injection profiles; the inputs and time resolution were not read. Format and access: MATLAB code on the RWTH Aachen public GitLab server, which answered the cloud with a bot check, so the code and README were not read. Licence: GNU General Public License v3.0, with other licensing on request (project page); copyright 2019. Caveats: listed on the G-PST Open Tools Portal under device modelling; activity dates were not read. Simulation uses: stochastic PV injection inputs for distribution grid simulations such as voltage and hosting capacity studies. Related records: SSMD (model-ssmd-state-space-linear-distribution-grid), from the same institute, models distribution grids with inverters.
